pending_request.scope: W30 late/mutable and higher-cap historical reconstruction only; no implementation admitted.
pending_request.owner: Customer privacy/security and delivery/DS owners with architecture; D06/W24
pending_request.question: What maximum late-arrival/correction window should the engine support, and may it retain the corresponding erasure-covered replay history?
pending_request.next_action: Obtain the D06/W24 owner decision for W30 historical recovery: maximum late-arrival/correction age, permitted replay-history/checkpoint retention and erasure lifecycle, and handling of already-unrecoverable history. Supporting a seven-day attribution policy requires its carry-in history as well as the chosen correction window; a 48-hour/200-entry live ring or erasure scan horizon does not establish that basis. Do not implement blind refolding, retain extra subject history or reset a generation by assumption. W30.03 remains accepted unchanged. Other authorized local remediation is not globally blocked; forward interrupted-fold recovery is a separate possible technical task, requiring an admitted design for exact input/config/tombstone identity, cross-shard validation, concurrent progress and guarded publication before coding. No customer-data recovery, cloud/deploy or release authority is supplied.
